AMENDED (revision 1): annotator/app.js joins t16's inScope. I re-read every ground you named on the live tree and all of them hold. Continue on this same attempt.

Route, as your report plans it:
1. Add one SHARED_WORDS row per slot name in annotator/app.js, in the shape that closePanel and bcCancelForm already use.
2. Delete the COPY rows at annotator/vision-stage.js:105 and :213, and the ops row at annotator/ops.js:44. Paint the ops field from say('bfPaste') at annotator/ops.js:657.
3. Write tests/test_console_paste_label_owner.py with the three cases, then take the bites with the sha1 restore.

Two cautions:
- Key the guard on the quoted slot name 'bfPaste'. The bare prefix also matches bfPasteId at annotator/ops.js:520.
- The verify list now names tests/test_console_round79_owners.py, because that case holds the same decision and must stay green.

Report to /tmp/dshsess/report_r106_writerW4.md as before.
